text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- The number of applications for shares in the forthcoming privatisation of utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal has exceeded the government's expectations, Under Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira dos Santos said.
- The board of private television channel TVI says the future of the company will depend on its creditors.
- North American communications company RSL Communications has bought a 30 percent stake in local telecommunications firm Maxitel.

- The ruling Socialist party has gained two percentage points to 35 percent of voters' intentions, while the opposition Social Democrat Party has dropped by six points to 28 percent, according to an opinion poll.
- Private television network SIC is negotiating with a South African partner to buy a 20 percent stake in RTK, a Mozambican TV channel, the director of SIC, Goncalves Pereira, said.
- According to a study of the turnover of Portuguese companies between 1990 and 1994, utilities were the most dynamic sector.
